title: Thai-Style Vegetarian Skewers
description: A flavorful and colorful vegetarian skewer dish inspired by Thai cuisine, featuring marinated tofu and vegetables.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: extra-firm, drained and cut into 1-inch cubes

ingredients.name: khanom
ingredients.notes: Thai-style rice noodles, soaked and drained

ingredients.name: pandan leaves
ingredients.notes: fresh or dried, for wrapping skewers

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together quick sauce, 1 tablespoon of oil, and 1 tablespoon of chopped fresh cilantro.
Add the tofu, bell peppers, onion, and mushrooms to the marinade and toss to coat.
Thread the marinated vegetables and tofu onto the pandan leaves, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and lightly charred.
Serve the skewers hot with a side of Thai-style barbecue sauce for dipping.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and a sprinkle of toasted peanuts, if desired.
